players.fr: Clube de Regatas Vasco da Gama

rules.note: Winter window opens 1 January and closes within three days of 31 January (Rule V.3); bench of nine, five substitutions (Rule L.29); squad list of 25, at most 17 not home-grown (A.1.283).

cup.name: Coupe de France
cup.note: dates assumed (Ligue 1 clubs enter in the round of 64)

cup.name: Coppa Italia
cup.note: first round, round of 32 and round of 16 on dates from the club pages; quarter-finals, semi-finals (one match here, two legs in reality) and the final assumed

cup.name: Copa del Rey
cup.note: 2026/27 dates from the Transfermarkt cup page (first round 27 October to 18 November) and the Wikipedia season page (RFEF calendar): second round 2 December, round of 32 16 December, round of 16 6 January, quarter-finals 13 January, semi-finals 10 February and 3 March (one match here), final 24 April 2027 at La Cartuja, Seville. Reserve teams may not enter.

cup.name: DFB-Pokal
cup.note: 2026/27 dates from the club pages (first round 21 to 24 August, Bayern and Dortmund on 1 and 2 September after the Supercup; second round 27/28 October; round of 16 1/2 December) and the DFB Rahmentermine (quarter-finals 2/3 and 9/10 February 2027, semi-finals 20/21 April, final 29 May 2027 at the Olympiastadion Berlin). 64 clubs in reality, the two Bundesligas here.

cup.name: Kup Srbije
cup.note: First round 28 October 2026 from the club pages (Super liga and Prva liga clubs, 27/28 October; Dubocica v Radnicki Nis on 18 November). The later dates are estimates until a Kup Srbije page gives them: round of 16 early December, quarter-finals mid-March, semi-finals late April (last season's semi-final was on 30 April 2026), final in May. 32 clubs in reality, the Super liga and the Prva liga here.

ic.note: Format from the 2025 regulations (art. 4): M1 CAF v OFC, M2 AFC v winner of M1 (home grounds, hosts alternate yearly), M3 Concacaf v CONMEBOL, M4 winner of M3 v winner of M2, M5 UEFA v winner of M4 (neutral). 2026: the first two matches' clubs and dates from Transfermarkt (their results are not used: the game replays the season); the December dates follow 2025's (10, 13, 17 December), a year on. Toluca are the 2026 Concacaf club (2026 Concacaf Champions Cup winners); the CONMEBOL club, the 2026 Libertadores winners, is decided on 28 November 2026.

qualified.note: Already qualified for 2029 (continental winners of 2025 and 2026). The other places: the strongest of their continent among the clubs in the data; the host place: the strongest club left from outside Europe.
